(()=>{const t=document.querySelector('.alteration-stage-content input:not([type="checkbox"])');if(!t)throw Error('Stage reference input missing');Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set.call(t,'Reviewed Stage Coordination Set S01');t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));const c=document.querySelector('.alteration-stage-confirm input');if(!c.checked)c.click();return true})()
(()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent.trim()==='Review stage geometry');if(!b)throw Error('Review stage geometry button missing');b.click();return true})()

(()=>{const sel=document.querySelector('select[aria-label="Alteration preview stage"]');if(!sel)throw Error('Stage select missing');sel.value='proposed';sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));return true;})()
